newsitem.title: UK: Uk's FTSE 100 index falls more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Uk's FTSE 100 index falls more than 50 points.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 share index fell to a day's low of 4,600.7 in late trade on Friday, a drop of 53 points, as interest rate and pre-Budget concerns continued to dog the UK market, dealers said.
Despite a continued rally on Wall Street, the mood in London remained gloomy, dealers said, with few players prepared to buy and several unloading large quantities of shares.

Expectations that the new Labour government's July 2 Budget will abolish the tax breaks on dividend payments for pension funds and a growing conviction that British interest rates will rise next month were behind the bearish tone, analysts said.
